- `addTransaction` is `public`. It has no `ownerExists(msg.sender)` or `onlyWallet` access control. The only modifier is `notNull(destination)`, which rejects `address(0)` but does not restrict the caller.

{Function:addTransaction,Taint Path:external caller -> addTransaction(destination,value,data) -> transactions[transactionId] write,Description:Public addTransaction lacks ownerExists/onlyWallet access control; any external account can create arbitrary transaction records.}
{Function:addTransaction,Taint Path:external caller -> addTransaction -> transactionCount += 1,Description:Public addTransaction lacks ownerExists/onlyWallet access control; any external account can increment transactionCount and consume transaction IDs.}
